mapping_method: Preserve all154 previous mappings except explicit genuine Q18 survival additions; append all9 surviving real-core questions before any expanded answers. Separate unasked key background. Reachability credit remains separate from grading requirements.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

creator_provenance.role: Complete independently accepted original-native preview procedure addition18

questions.question: If a Power’s Range was increased and it was made Fast, what happens on Repeat? If Elements enabling a non-Range threshold have been lost, does the Repeat automatically retain that threshold?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Power’s Range was increased and it was made Fast, what happens on Repeat? If Elements enabling a non-Range threshold have been lost, does the Repeat automatically retain that threshold?
required_facts: Range and Speed modifications carry over to Repeat, retaining the boosted Range and Fast Speed.
Other thresholds check current Elements and may no longer apply after Elements are lost.

questions.question: What happens when Powerstorm itself is Repeated, and can its threshold spend all three Repeat permissions on the same Power Card?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What happens when Powerstorm itself is Repeated, and can its threshold spend all three Repeat permissions on the same Power Card?
required_facts: Ignore Repeat instructions when repeating Powerstorm; it grants no further Repeat permissions.
Target Spirit still gains 3 Energy from the repeated Powerstorm.
Its threshold permits up to three different cards, not three repetitions of the same card.

questions.question: A Power says Repeat this Power in an adjacent land, but that land fails the original Blight target restriction or normal Range. Is it legal, and can the original land be selected?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Power says Repeat this Power in an adjacent land, but that land fails the original Blight target restriction or normal Range. Is it legal, and can the original land be selected?
required_facts: A specified adjacent-land Repeat uses that location instruction in place of ordinary Range/Target restrictions.
It can target the adjacent land despite the original Blight or Range condition.
It cannot target the original land, which is not adjacent to itself.

questions.question: Is Presence destroyed on moving into an already-Blighted land? If a cascade loops back into a land it already hit, can it destroy Presence there again, and does existing Blight quantity multiply cascading?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Is Presence destroyed on moving into an already-Blighted land? If a cascade loops back into a land it already hit, can it destroy Presence there again, and does existing Blight quantity multiply cascading?
required_facts: Entering an already-Blighted land does not destroy Presence.
A new cascade addition returning there can destroy one Presence per Spirit again.
Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the outgoing cascade.

questions.question: If a Healthy Blight pool empties before a cascade is complete, when do you flip/refill and do you finish the cascade? Does removing Blight restore destroyed Presence?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Healthy Blight pool empties before a cascade is complete, when do you flip/refill and do you finish the cascade? Does removing Blight restore destroyed Presence?
required_facts: On Healthy pool exhaustion immediately flip/refill as directed and continue unfinished cascade/additions.
Removing Blight does not restore destroyed Presence.

key_context_not_required.fact: No setup +1 on flip; removing Blight does not flip back Healthy.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: These facts are requested by Q14; Q45 asks mid-cascade flip timing/continuation and Presence restoration.

key_context_not_required.fact: Removed Blight returns to the currently active Blight pool.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The removal clause asks whether destroyed Presence is restored; it does not ask where the removed token goes.

questions.question: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?
required_facts: A cascade is part of the original single-land Ravage action tree, including across boards.
It is not an independent outcome-check boundary.
Players may choose the land order and win after one complete Ravage tree before a later land would cause loss.

questions.question: A Stage III Ravage lists Sands and Jungles. Before it starts one matching land is empty. A triggered effect during another Ravage moves an Invader into that empty land and more Invaders into a land already due to Ravage. Which lands Ravage and which Invaders participate?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Stage III Ravage lists Sands and Jungles. Before it starts one matching land is empty. A triggered effect during another Ravage moves an Invader into that empty land and more Invaders into a land already due to Ravage. Which lands Ravage and which Invaders participate?
required_facts: Determine the matching lands eligible to Ravage before resolving that card.
The initially empty land does not begin Ravaging when an Invader later arrives.
New Invaders entering an already queued land participate when that land Ravages.

key_context_not_required.fact: Players may choose any order across both terrains.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks eligible lands and participating Invaders; it does not ask players to choose or describe land order.

questions.question: What does the Coastal Lands Invader card affect when Exploring, Building and Ravaging, and do its Build/Ravage effects bypass usual requirements?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What does the Coastal Lands Invader card affect when Exploring, Building and Ravaging, and do its Build/Ravage effects bypass usual requirements?
required_facts: Coastal Lands affects all Coastal lands on all boards for Explore and its later Build/Ravage.
Ordinary requirements still apply to Build/Ravage; it does not bypass Invader presence requirements.

key_context_not_required.fact: Explore requires sources, with the Ocean providing coastal access.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The requested requirements contrast singles out Build/Ravage; all Coastals affected by this card already have Ocean access.

questions.question: If a Year of Perfect Stillness or Paralyzing Fright skips actions in a land containing a Town, does it stop an adjacent matching land Exploring from that Town?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Year of Perfect Stillness or Paralyzing Fright skips actions in a land containing a Town, does it stop an adjacent matching land Exploring from that Town?
required_facts: Skipping actions in the source Town's land does not prevent adjacent matching lands Exploring from that Town.
The source check occurs for the destination's Explore, not an action in the source land.

questions.question: After Invader cards advance, can Slow Powers remove a newly added Explorer to prevent a future Build, or has it already Built? When does Fear from a Slow Power normally resolve?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: After Invader cards advance, can Slow Powers remove a newly added Explorer to prevent a future Build, or has it already Built? When does Fear from a Slow Power normally resolve?
required_facts: The just-added Explorer has only Explored; the card is in Build for next turn.
A Slow Power may remove it before then and thereby prevent a future Build if no Invaders remain.
Fear cards earned in Slow normally resolve in the next Invader Phase's Fear step.

questions.question: Do each-player Fear choices need different lands or pieces, and may a player use another Spirit’s Sacred Site for a generic Fear-card condition? What if the card explicitly counts each Spirit’s own Sacred Sites?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do each-player Fear choices need different lands or pieces, and may a player use another Spirit’s Sacred Site for a generic Fear-card condition? What if the card explicitly counts each Spirit’s own Sacred Sites?
required_facts: Each-player choices need different lands/pieces only when the card says so.
The same piece may be affected/moved by successive legal player choices.
A generic Presence/Sacred Site condition may use another Spirit's.
Explicit own-Sacred-Site counts use each Spirit's sites individually.

questions.question: An effect removes two Invaders in a land with two Cities. Must Explorers be removed first, and if a card instead allows removing a number of Health worth, does existing Damage reduce that Health?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: An effect removes two Invaders in a land with two Cities. Must Explorers be removed first, and if a card instead allows removing a number of Health worth, does existing Damage reduce that Health?
required_facts: Remove two Invaders can remove both Cities; no Explorer-first rule applies.
Marked Damage does not reduce Health for that allowance.

key_context_not_required.fact: A Health-based removal allowance uses current Health, including any Health modifiers.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The Health subquestion specifically asks whether already marked Damage reduces Health. It supplies no Health modifier and does not ask modifier handling.

questions.question: If a condition says Dahan outnumber Towns/Cities, can it hold with zero buildings? What if both sides are zero?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a condition says Dahan outnumber Towns/Cities, can it hold with zero buildings? What if both sides are zero?
required_facts: At least one Dahan outnumbers zero Towns/Cities.
Zero versus zero is not outnumbering.

questions.question: How does one-Spirit solo change Another Spirit targeting and conditional other-Spirit bonuses? Does one human playing two Spirits get that same self-targeting exception or use one-person setup scaling?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: How does one-Spirit solo change Another Spirit targeting and conditional other-Spirit bonuses? Does one human playing two Spirits get that same self-targeting exception or use one-person setup scaling?
required_facts: A one-Spirit solo game may target itself with Another Spirit.
Bonuses conditioned on actually targeting a different Spirit do not activate.
One person playing two Spirits fills two player roles and scales setup by two.
It does not get the single-Spirit self-target exception.

questions.question: When players disagree about a Power’s choices, a Blight cascade destination, or a decision outside any land, who ultimately decides?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When players disagree about a Power’s choices, a Blight cascade destination, or a decision outside any land, who ultimately decides?
required_facts: The Power user decides Power choices.
For other decisions seek consensus.
Without consensus, a decision within/about a land belongs to the Spirit starting on that board.
A non-land decision falls to the owner/organizer.

questions.question: Do low-complexity Spirits always have to use Power Progression? If used, how are gains and Major Forgetting handled, and how does the introductory no-Blight-Card game end from Blight?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do low-complexity Spirits always have to use Power Progression? If used, how are gains and Major Forgetting handled, and how does the introductory no-Blight-Card game end from Blight?
required_facts: Power Progression is an optional teaching aid, not compulsory for low-complexity Spirits.
When used, take the next listed card rather than draw 4/keep 1.
Gaining a Major still requires Forgetting.
In the no-card introductory game, emptying the board Blight pool loses without a flip.

key_context_not_required.fact: No-card initial pool is 5 per Spirit +1.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The no-card part asks how the game ends from Blight, not the initial pool amount; Q01 asks that amount.

questions.question: For Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III, may each player choose a land already containing Dahan and Gather zero? Must chosen lands differ and is Damage per Invader?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III, may each player choose a land already containing Dahan and Gather zero? Must chosen lands differ and is Damage per Invader?
required_facts: At Terror II/III Dahan Enheartened may choose a land already containing Dahan and Gather zero.
Each player's chosen land must differ.
The listed Damage at both levels is an aggregate total in the chosen land, not that amount to each Invader.

key_context_not_required.fact: At Terror II the card does 1 total Damage if Dahan are present.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The damage clause asks whether Damage is per Invader. An answer identifying the listed Damage as an aggregate total answers that clause without reciting the two printed numerical formulae.

key_context_not_required.fact: At Terror III the total Damage equals the number of Dahan present.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The damage clause asks whether Damage is per Invader. An answer identifying the listed Damage as an aggregate total answers that clause without reciting the two printed numerical formulae.

questions.question: Under Overseas Trade Seems Safer II, a Coastal land would build a City and a second would build a Town. What happens in each? Does Trade Suffers III allow an Inland City to be downgraded?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Under Overseas Trade Seems Safer II, a Coastal land would build a City and a second would build a Town. What happens in each? Does Trade Suffers III allow an Inland City to be downgraded?
required_facts: Overseas Trade II entirely skips the Coastal Build that would add a City; it does not substitute a Town.
The Coastal Build that would add a Town proceeds.
Trade Suffers III can downgrade only in Coastal lands, so not an Inland City.

questions.question: A single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power resolves, then some Dahan leave. Compare that with Dahan on their Guard and with Encompassing Ward when Presence moves.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power resolves, then some Dahan leave. Compare that with Dahan on their Guard and with Encompassing Ward when Presence moves.
required_facts: An ordinary single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power fixes its value when used; later Dahan departure does not lower it.
Dahan on their Guard checks current Dahan when the ongoing Defend matters.
Encompassing Ward follows the target Spirit's current Presence, gaining/losing lands as it moves.
